question: In which of the following battles did Ahmadullah Shah defeat Henry Lawrence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Battle of Chinhat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The famous **battle of Chinhat** in Ismailganj of Lucknow(Uttar Pradesh) on 30 June 1857, opposed **British forces' guidance by Henry Lawrence. **
 
• Henry Lawrence died as an out-turn of an aggressive Battle.
 
• **Barkat shah** guides one of the most powerful armies with **Ahmadullah Shah** as his leader

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Third Battle of Panipat took place on 14 January 1761 between the Maratha Empire and the captured army of the Durrani Afghan Empire.** The battle took place in and around the city of Panipat, in the north of Delhi.
 
• The **Battle of Plassey was a conclusive success of the British East India Company on the Nawab of Bengal and his French merge on 23 June 1757**, under the lead under the guidance of Robert Clive.
 
• The** Battle of Buxar was fought between 22 and 23 October 1764**, **between the forces under the order of the British East India Company, headed by Hector Munro, **and the **integrated armies of Mir Qasim, Nawab of Bengal 1764.**
